speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
text: asked the Minister for Education (a) whether any studies have been conducted to analyse the mental health issues faced by students; and (b) whether more measures are needed to deal with these mental health issues, in light of reports that suicide remains the leading cause of death amongst youths.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi) (for the Minister for Education)
text: MOE also provides parents with up-to-date information packages to enable them to better support their child's mental well-being.

speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
text: One of the concerns underlying this question was the article that said that suicide was the leading cause of death amongst youths.

speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
text: Has the MOE done any studies into these suicide cases to see if there any lessons to be learnt and how best early intervention might have helped in each of these cases so that we can prevent or reduce the number of future cases?

speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
text: Again, this particular research rests with the national agencies looking at the numbers of suicides as well as death globally and that is something that we can come to if the Member has a specific question in relation to that particular trend.

speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
text: That, notwithstanding, if I may add, in the context of MOE, we do look at the different tiers in terms of intervention.

speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
text: So, from the level of the students, as we have mentioned earlier, with regards to any opportunity, with regards to mental health education, that is something that we address.

speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
text: We also equip our teachers with skills and basic counselling skills to be able to identify any early signs of distress among our students.

speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
text: So, in terms of mental well-being and care for our students, as well as youths in general, it is a whole entire ecosystem of support.
